name_input: MUVALL CASTORS PRIVATE LIMITED; MUVALL CASTORS PRIVATE LIMITED
actual_hs_list: 4013.90 — inner tubes, other: declared code, only partially applicable
4012.90 / 4016.99 — rubber-tyred wheels and rubber articles: closest fit for solid/elastic rubber castor wheels
3926.90 — articles of plastics, other: PVC, PU, PP, UHMW, cast-nylon, phenolic castor wheels
7326.90 — other articles of iron/steel: cast-iron-core PU wheels, stainless-steel castor brackets, metal trolleys
8482.99 / 8483.90 — castor/roller bearing assemblies and parts (if supplied as components)

product_summary: Manufacturer of industrial castor wheels / caster wheels and trolley wheels, Rajajinagar, Bengaluru (No.45/28, Gubbanna Industrial Estate, 6th Block). Product lines listed on muvallcastors.com: PVC castor wheel, polyurethane (PU) castor wheel, thermoplastic rubber castor wheel, polypropylene castor wheel, nylon castor wheel, UHMW polymer castor wheels, solid rubber castor wheels, elastic rubber castor wheels, cast-iron-core PU castor wheel, cast nylon castor wheel, PU tapered castor wheels, stainless steel castor wheel, levelling castor, HAC castor, scaffolding castor, low-profile castor, spring-loaded castor, ESD (electrostatic dissipative) castor, high-temperature castor, phenolic (heat-resistant) castor, glass-filled nylon (heat-resistant) castor, pallet truck rollers & wheels, pneumatic rubber castor wheel, foot lock, platform trolley, plastic trolley, metal trolley. Load range stated 10 kg to 5 t per wheel; 1,500+ SKUs; ISO 9001; part of Metcon Associates (est. 1985); Muvall brand since 2013. Source: https://www.muvallcastors.com/ and https://www.muvallcastors.com/about-us (both read).
role_hint: manufacturer (site states own design and manufacturing in Rajajinagar, Bengaluru; also states 150+ dealers and stock points in Chennai and Bhiwandi — dealer network is a distribution sign, not a trader sign for the entity itself). No customs line seen, so manufacturing status is 'заявлено, не подтверждено'.
comment: HS 4013.90 is the residual heading for rubber inner tubes and is a poor fit for this product range. Castor wheels here are predominantly non-rubber: PVC, PU, PP, nylon, UHMW, phenolic, glass-filled nylon, cast nylon — these are plastics articles (3926.90), and the metal-framed/stainless/cast-iron-core variants and metal trolleys fall under 7326.90 or 8302.20 (castors of base metal). Only the solid rubber, elastic rubber, thermoplastic rubber and pneumatic rubber lines plausibly touch chapter 40, and even then 4012.90/4016.99 is a better fit than 4013.90. Verdict: partial — the declared code captures at most the rubber-wheel minority of the range and misses the plastics and base-metal castor lines entirely. Per project rule 3 the company is NOT rejected on HS grounds; the code should be corrected to the actual mix (3926.90 / 7326.90 / 8302.20 / 4016.99) per shipment. Industry claimed as 'Авиастроение и транспорт' (aviation & transport) is a misclassification: the actual industry is material handling / industrial components (castors, wheels, trolleys), with automotive and warehousing only as end-use segments. Product lines missing from the declaration: plastic trolleys and metal trolleys (complete goods, not castor parts), pallet truck rollers, and the entire plastics castor range. No customs line, B/L or GST record was examined in this task, so all product claims are 'заявлено, не подтверждено' — the website is the only source. Revenue, export volumes, PAN, CIN and state were not researched per task scope and are null.
